description: Generate test 86: Subject E (Mathematical Abilities), Topic: Heights & Distances, 40 questions, difficulty_profile: standard. Save to mock-tests/tests/86_test_E_heights-distances.json. Then run python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py 86.

Generate 40 questions on Heights & Distances (Trigonometry applications) following the steering prompt rules: type distribution for 40Q is Single Correct MCQ: 16, Statement-based: 6, Assertion-Reason: 4, Matching: 4, Multiple Correct Combination: 4, Fill in the Blank: 2, Numerical Value: 2, Data Interpretation: 2. Ensure all questions follow the exact JSON schema from Section 5. Every explanation must explain why correct AND why each wrong option is wrong.
Ensure no question stem duplicates or near-duplicates any existing entry in history/E.json (especially test 49 which was also Heights & Distances).
Run: python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py 86 from the repo root to update history, config, manifest, and STUDY_PLAN.md.
